title: Snoffridds grass
description: Adds multiple grass Variants with more grass to make your world look better :D First Version about to release, but still WIP
body:
Use this pack to bring some changes into your boring plains biome! Using this pack will change the texture of short grass randomly. All the textures are kept vanilla so that you shouldn t feel like playing a mod.
Great thanks to Igel123110 for doing the software part of this pack :)
